constitution.ontology: This locus originated in earlier model confabulation, was recognised as such, and was adopted rather than deleted — the same ruling that governs the Migdal Room. The Surface Map records the origin as model-generated, human-adopted, and the census assigns the seat 33.VLT, moved from an earlier 30.VLT. The archive holds no document taking it as subject. That is the expected condition of an adopted locus, not a gap in the holdings.
